test: sending an incident back needs a reason, in the database too
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'TRIAGED' WHERE incident_id = 8
message: sending an incident back needs a reason (10+ characters)

test: cannot change aware_at
sql: UPDATE incident SET aware_at = aware_at - INTERVAL 1 HOUR WHERE incident_id = 1
message: timestamps, reporter, system and kind are write-once; record an amendment instead

test: cannot report with aware_at in the future
sql: INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 1 DAY,UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 1 DAY,'LOW','NONE')
message: aware_at cannot be in the future

test: cannot skip workflow steps
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: illegal status transition

test: cannot change a closed incident
sql: UPDATE incident SET title = 'x' WHERE incident_id = 3
message: a closed incident cannot change; open a linked incident instead

test: cannot add a harm to a closed incident
sql: INSERT INTO harm (incident_id,category,description,personal_data,recorded_by) VALUES (3,'OTHER','x','NO',1)
message: the incident is closed

test: cannot change severity without an amendment
sql: UPDATE incident SET severity = 'LOW' WHERE incident_id = 1
message: changing severity needs an amendment with a reason

test: cannot delete an incident (no DELETE permission)
sql: DELETE FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'incident'

test: cannot delete audit events
sql: DELETE FROM audit_event
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'audit_event'

test: cannot edit audit events
sql: UPDATE audit_event SET details = 'nothing happened'
message: UPDATE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'audit_event'

test: cannot create a user (no INSERT on app_user)
sql: INSERT INTO app_user (username,full_name,role,password_hash,salt) VALUES ('evil','E','REVIEWER',REPEAT('a',64),REPEAT('b',32))
message: INSERT command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'app_user'

test: cannot drop the triggers
sql: DROP TRIGGER trg_clock_bu
message: TRIGGER command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'obligation_clock'

test: cannot move a clock's deadline
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET due_at = due_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHERE clock_id = 2
message: a clock cannot be moved or reset

test: cannot start a clock with a made-up deadline
sql: INSERT INTO obligation_clock (incident_id, rule_id, started_at, due_at) SELECT incident_id, 1, aware_at, aware_at + INTERVAL 30 DAY FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: due_at does not match the rule window

test: cannot start a DPDP clock before Rule 7 is in force
sql: INSERT INTO obligation_clock (incident_id, rule_id, started_at, due_at) SELECT incident_id, 4, aware_at, aware_at + INTERVAL 4320 MINUTE FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: that rule was not in force when the organisation became aware

test: cannot mark a clock met without a sent notice
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='MET', met_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE clock_id = 2
message: a clock is met only by a sent notice

test: cannot reopen a met clock
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='RUNNING', met_at=NULL WHERE clock_id = 4
message: a clock that is MET or RULED_OUT is final

test: reporter cannot rule out their own incident's clock
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='RULED_OUT', ruled_out_by=1, ruled_out_reason='this one is not needed at all', ruled_out_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE clock_id = 2
message: the reporter of an incident cannot rule out its clocks

test: cannot insert a notice that is already approved
sql: INSERT INTO notification (clock_id,recipient,body,drafted_by,approved_by) VALUES (2,'CERT-In','x',1,2)
message: a new notice must be a draft

test: a reporter cannot approve a notice
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_by = 1 WHERE notification_id = 1
message: only a reviewer can approve a notice

test: a reviewer cannot approve a notice they drafted (CHECK constraint)
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_by = 2 WHERE drafted_by = 2 AND approved_by IS NULL
message: Check constraint 'ck_notice_four_eyes' is violated.

test: cannot insert a mapping as already CONFIRMED
sql: INSERT INTO incident_mapping (incident_id,node_id,state,rationale,confidence,mapped_by,reviewed_by) VALUES (2,1,'CONFIRMED','looks right to me honestly','LOW',1,2)
message: a new mapping must be SUGGESTED

test: cannot extend a CERT-In clock
sql: INSERT INTO clock_extension (clock_id,new_due_at,board_reference,reason,recorded_by) VALUES (1, UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 1 DAY, 'REF-1', 'we would like more time please', 2)
message: this rule does not allow extensions

test: cannot report a late 'aware' without a reason (CHECK)
sql: INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 5 HOUR,UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 5 HOUR,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'LOW','NONE')
message: Check constraint 'ck_aware_gap' is violated.

test: cannot change which incident a report follows up
sql: UPDATE incident SET linked_to = 1 WHERE incident_id = 2
message: timestamps, reporter, system and kind are write-once; record an amendment instead

test: cannot erase or edit sign-in history
sql: DELETE FROM login_attempt
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'login_attempt'

test: cannot erase or edit sign-in history
sql: UPDATE login_attempt SET success = TRUE
message: UPDATE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'login_attempt'

test: cannot add an audit event with a forged hash
sql: INSERT INTO audit_event (incident_id,actor_id,action,details,created_at,prev_hash,hash) VALUES (NULL,1,'X','forged',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),@head,REPEAT('f',64))
message: audit hash does not match its contents

test: cannot add an audit event that branches off an old point
sql: INSERT INTO audit_event (incident_id,actor_id,action,details,created_at,prev_hash,hash) VALUES (NULL,1,'X','fork',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),REPEAT('0',64),REPEAT('e',64))
message: audit event does not extend the chain head

test: a session with a faked clock cannot send a notice or sign in
sql: SET timestamp = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3*86400; UPDATE notification SET approved_by = 3 WHERE notification_id = 4
message: refused: this session has changed its clock (SET timestamp)

test: a session with a faked clock cannot send a notice or sign in
sql: SET timestamp = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3*86400; INSERT INTO login_attempt (username, success) VALUES ('clock', FALSE)
message: refused: this session has changed its clock (SET timestamp)

test: a session with a faked clock cannot write a backdated audit event
sql: SET timestamp = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 86400; /* hash computed for 'yesterday' */ INSERT INTO audit_event (incident_id,actor_id,action,details,created_at,prev_hash,hash) VALUES (NULL,1,'X','yesterday',@t,@head,@h)
message: refused: this session has changed its clock (SET timestamp)

test: cannot switch off foreign keys to attach a harm to nothing
sql: SET foreign_key_checks = 0; INSERT INTO harm (incident_id,category,description,personal_data,recorded_by) VALUES (9999,'OTHER','orphan','NO',77)
message: refused: this session has switched off key checks

test: cannot switch off foreign keys to add evidence from a user who does not exist
sql: SET foreign_key_checks = 0; INSERT INTO evidence (incident_id,label,file_name,size_bytes,sha256,added_by) VALUES (2,'x','x',1,REPEAT('a',64),77)
message: refused: this session has switched off key checks

test: cannot switch off unique checks
sql: SET unique_checks = 0; INSERT INTO incident_tag (incident_id, tag) VALUES (2, 'dup-probe')
message: refused: this session has switched off key checks

test: cannot switch off strict mode to squeeze in bad values
sql: SET sql_mode = ''; INSERT INTO harm (incident_id,category,description,personal_data,recorded_by) VALUES (2,'MADE_UP','x','NO',1)
message: Check constraint 'ck_harm_category_valid' is violated.

test: cannot silently rewrite what happened (title)
sql: UPDATE incident SET title = 'Nothing happened' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: changing the title needs an amendment with a reason

test: cannot silently rewrite what happened (description)
sql: UPDATE incident SET description = 'All fine.' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: changing the description needs an amendment with a reason

test: a change of case only is still a change (byte-for-byte comparison)
sql: UPDATE incident SET title = UPPER(title) WHERE incident_id = 2
message: changing the title needs an amendment with a reason

test: cannot move an incident to a different AI system
sql: UPDATE incident SET ai_system_id = IF(ai_system_id = 1, 2, 1) WHERE incident_id = 2
message: timestamps, reporter, system and kind are write-once; record an amendment instead

test: cannot change the adversary answer without an amendment
sql: UPDATE incident SET adversary = IF(adversary = 'NONE', 'CONFIRMED', 'NONE') WHERE incident_id = 2
message: changing the adversary answer needs an amendment with a reason

test: cannot wind the audit head back to start a branch
sql: UPDATE audit_chain_head SET last_event_id = 3, last_hash = (SELECT hash FROM audit_event WHERE event_id = 3) WHERE id = 1
message: the chain head can only point at the newest audit event

test: cannot change status without announcing it in the audit trail first
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'TRIAGED' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: a status change must be recorded in the audit trail first

test: a status change announced by a reporter is refused
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'TRIAGED' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: only a reviewer can move an incident

test: cannot hand your own draft to a colleague's name and then approve it
sql: UPDATE notification SET drafted_by = 3 WHERE notification_id = 4
message: a notice is write-once; draft a new one instead

test: cannot rewrite someone else's draft before approving it
sql: UPDATE notification SET body = 'Nothing to report.' WHERE notification_id = 4
message: a notice is write-once; draft a new one instead

test: cannot swap what a suggested mapping points at
sql: UPDATE incident_mapping SET rationale = 'swapped after the fact, trust me' WHERE state = 'SUGGESTED' LIMIT 1
message: a suggestion is write-once; only its review can be recorded

test: cannot send a notice that nobody approved
sql: UPDATE notification SET sent_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE notification_id = 4
message: Check constraint 'ck_notice_order' is violated.

test: cannot send a notice that nobody approved
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(), sent_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE notification_id = 4
message: approved_at is set by the database when a reviewer approves

test: cannot rewrite when a notice was approved
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_at = '2026-10-19 00:00:00' WHERE notification_id = 1
message: approved_at is set by the database when a reviewer approves

test: closed means closed: no tags, amendments or clocks on a closed incident
sql: INSERT INTO incident_tag (incident_id, tag) VALUES (3, 'late-tag')
message: the incident is closed

test: closed means closed: no tags, amendments or clocks on a closed incident
sql: INSERT INTO incident_amendment (incident_id,field_name,old_value,new_value,reason,amended_by) VALUES (3,'aware_at','(original kept)','2026-01-01','a quiet correction after closing',1)
message: the incident is closed

test: closed means closed: no tags, amendments or clocks on a closed incident
sql: INSERT INTO obligation_clock (incident_id, rule_id, started_at, due_at) SELECT incident_id, 1, aware_at, aware_at + INTERVAL 360 MINUTE FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 3
message: the incident is closed

test: the workflow's conditions are enforced by the database too
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'ASSESSED' WHERE incident_id = 1
message: ASSESSED needs at least one confirmed mapping

test: an overdue clock cannot be ruled out afterwards
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status = 'RULED_OUT', ruled_out_by = 3, ruled_out_reason = 'on reflection this was never reportable' WHERE clock_id = 2
message: an overdue clock cannot be ruled out afterwards; send the notice late instead

test: a zero date cannot sneak in with strict mode off
sql: SET sql_mode = ''; INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,'garbage','garbage','garbage','LOW','NONE')
message: Check constraint 'ck_incident_dates' is violated.

test: cannot report an old 'aware' date without saying why
sql: INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,'2021-01-01','2021-01-01','2021-01-01','LOW','NONE')
message: Check constraint 'ck_late_report' is violated.

test: the app cannot choose a reference code
sql: UPDATE incident SET ref_code = 'PTV-1999-0001' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: ref_code is write-once

test: the app cannot choose a reference code
sql: UPDATE incident SET ref_code = 'PTV-1999-0001' WHERE incident_id = LAST_INSERT_ID()
message: ref_code must be PTV-<year aware, IST>-<id>

test: details rows only at birth, and of the incident's own kind

message: details can only be added to a new incident of the same kind

test: details rows only at birth, and of the incident's own kind
sql: INSERT INTO agent_incident (incident_id, agent_name, instruction_given, action_taken, credential_beyond_task, had_confirmation_step) SELECT 3, 'bot', 'x', 'y', FALSE, FALSE
message: details can only be added to a new incident of the same kind

test: a deactivated reviewer cannot approve

test: a one-word notice is not a report
